t: 孔戈君主恩克武·恩辛格受葡萄牙传教士的洗礼,采用若昂一世的洗礼名.
te: Kongo monarch Nkuwu Nzinga is baptised by Portuguese missionaries, adopting the baptismal name of João I.
dz: 孔戈君主恩克武·恩辛格受葡萄牙传教士的洗礼,采用若昂一世的洗礼名.
de: Kongo monarch Nkuwu Nzinga is baptised by Portuguese missionaries, adopting the baptismal name of João I.

te: An auto-da-fé, held in the Brasero de la Dehesa outside of Ávila, concludes the case of the Holy Child of La Guardia wi…
dz: 在阿维拉外的布拉塞罗德德赫萨(英语:Brasero de la Dehesa)举行的一次自动处决,结束了拉瓜地亚圣子案,公开处决了几名犹太人和口才疑犯.
de: An auto-da-fé, held in the Brasero de la Dehesa outside of Ávila, concludes the case of the Holy Child of La Guardia with the public execution of several Jewish and converso suspects.

te: The siege of Granada, the last Moorish stronghold in Spain, ends with the Treaty of Granada.
dz: 对格拉纳达的围攻是西班牙最后的摩里什据点,以"格拉纳达条约"而结束.
